title: Dos Boy is making waves with the release of his latest track “In The Hills”.
htmlContent:
Dos Boy is a talented rapper and songwriter from Byron Bay, Australia, well known for his high-energy live performances and raw honesty in his lyrics. Dos Boy is a name that lingers, and the same can be said with his music as he releases his recent track "In the hills."

Dos Boy's "In the Hills" is his intro track off his "Horrorscope" EP, released on the 10th of February. "In the Hills" is a true musical luxury on display with his rich singing and production that you can get lost in, which carries a certain sophistication you will admire.
